name: Nova Ljubljanska Banka d.d.
summary: Nova Ljubljanska Banka d.d., together with its subsidiaries, provides various banking services for retail and corporate clients in Slovenia, South East Europe, and Western Europe. It operates through Retail Banking in Slovenia, Corporate and Investment Banking in Slovenia, Strategic Foreign Markets, Financial Markets in Slovenia, Non-Core Members, and Other segments. The company offers saving, deposits, and business accounts; and personal, home, and green housing loans. It also provides credit, debit, and deferred payment cards, as well as other services; savings and investment products; security trading; and digital services.
